notes: Small additive revision-training-impact build. Approval of a replacement RA, COSHH RA or SSW now requires a deliberate training-impact decision: No retraining required, Self-training required, or Instructor-led retraining required. The decision is recorded before approval and database enforcement prevents a replacement trainable version being approved without it. For RA/COSHH replacements Safety Tracker reads the pending PDF for residual/post-control risk guidance; choosing No retraining or Self-training against an Instructor-led recommendation requires a recorded justification. No retraining carries forward each person's existing completion and original refresher due date without creating a false new sign-off. People who were not already current still have to complete the current training. Self-training and Instructor-led choices apply only to the new revision requirement; once that revision is completed, the normal scheduled refresher method again controls future renewals. Revision decisions are audit logged with old/new version, Manager, date, risk guidance and reason. Supabase migration revision_training_impact_v21062 applied.
